mapper.select:
SELECT ii.`province`, COUNT(distinct da.ip) count FROM `doh_attribute` da JOIN `ip_information` ii ON da.ip = ii.ip where ii.country = '中国' and da.`rounds` = (select MAX(rounds) FROM doh_attribute) and ii.province IS NOT NULL AND ii.province != '' GROUP BY ii.province
order by count desc

SELECT ii.`country`, COUNT(distinct da.ip) count FROM `doh_attribute` da JOIN `ip_information` ii ON da.ip = ii.ip where da.`rounds` = (SELECT DISTINCT MAX(rounds) FROM doh_attribute) GROUP BY ii.country order by count desc

SELECT province,SUM(count) count FROM ( SELECT ii.`province`,COUNT(distinct da.ip) count,da.ip FROM `doh_attribute` da JOIN `ip_information` ii ON da.ip = ii.ip where ii.province IS NOT NULL AND ii.province !=''
and da.ip = #{params.ip}
GROUP BY ii.province
UNION ALL
SELECT ii.`province`,COUNT(distinct s.ip) COUNT, s.ip FROM `scan_result` s JOIN `ip_information` ii ON s.ip = ii.ip where ii.province IS NOT NULL AND ii.province !=''
and s.ip = #{params.ip}
GROUP BY ii.province ) a1
GROUP BY a1.province

SELECT component,SUM(COUNT) count FROM ( SELECT da.component,COUNT(distinct da.ip) COUNT,da.ip FROM `doh_attribute` da
da.ip = #{params.ip}
GROUP BY da.component,da.ip
UNION ALL
SELECT s.component,COUNT(distinct s.ip) COUNT ,s.ip FROM `scan_result` s GROUP BY s.component,s.ip) a1 where component IS NOT NULL AND component !=''
and a1.ip = #{params.ip}
GROUP BY a1.component

SELECT COUNT(distinct da.ip) FROM doh_attribute da
da.ip = #{params.ip}
